weaknesses.coach: Plenty of the ball, but not much going forward. Let's hurt 'em with it.

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 8.6 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, that 8.6 is the kind of night that makes an old coach believe in magic. Top 10% of midfielders.

DID WELL
+ 25 passes. The team ran through you like a highway through a small town.
+ A brace against Trotted On, your 2nd straight match scoring. You put it where the keeper ain't. That's the whole trick.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. Put that one on the fridge.
+ 0.6 above your usual. Somebody's been eating their Wheaties.
+ 3 shots on target earned +0.1. That's interest on hard work.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Try this: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.
- 68% passing (17 of 25). If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- No key passes from 25 passes. Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
- You and tuxedo_slide share this one: defensive work rate. Tandem fix: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Five minutes of this: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.

If I had a gold star sticker, you'd get the whole sheet. - Coach Lasso

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 54% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 11 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 8.4 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, an 8.4 is a whole lotta good. Top quarter of midfielders, and you made it look easy.

DID WELL
+ A brace against Trotted On, your 2nd straight match scoring. Cool as the other side of the pillow.
+ 1 key pass. That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 3 shots on target: +0.1. The kind of thing nobody notices except me and the rating.
+ top 25% of midfielders, league-wide. Not bad for a weeknight.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (6 of 11). Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
- Only 11 passes. Quick one: Play with your head up between touches. You can't find a pass you never looked for.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- BellyTb1 had the same defensive work rate trouble. Team up on it: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Training-ground special: Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.

Go tell somebody you love about that one. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs Trotted On | You: 7.3 (above average FOR)
push.body:
Solid shift, PhogsToffees. A 7.3 clears the bar for a forward, and solid is the soil good things grow in.

DID WELL
+ 1 key pass. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ You and BellyTb1 linked up like peanut butter and jelly. Keep making sandwiches.
+ Beat Trotted On 4-2. That's a W you were part of, and W's are contagious.

WORK ON
- No shots. Ask for it early in the half-space, where a first-time finish is on.
- 72% passing (23 of 32). A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.
- forcing passes snagged you and BellyTb1 both. Buddy system: give each other short options.
- 0.7 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.

This week's homework: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.

You're closer than you think. Trust the process, and trust your teammates. - Coach Lasso
